text: The Patriots head into Week 6 hosting the Jets at Gillette Stadium on Sunday at 1 PM ET, but they'll do so with a significantly depleted roster following their dominant 45-17 victory over the Raiders in which Drake Maye orchestrated five touchdowns despite missing his top receiver and both starting cornerbacks. Left tackle Will Campbell suffered an MCL sprain in his right knee and is expected to miss game action, while running back TreVeyon Henderson's high ankle sprain will sideline him for multiple weeks—a pair of injuries that came during that same Raiders win and represent serious losses for an offense and offensive line already navigating injuries. To address depth issues, the Patriots signed RB Hassan Haskins and CB D'Shawn Jamison to the practice squad while releasing LB Jose Ramirez. The silver lining amid the injury carnage is that Maye appears to have found his rhythm after a slow start to the season, raising the question of whether he can sustain that momentum against a division opponent even with key pieces missing up front and in the backfield.
